paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD study of topological susceptibility used to bound the axion decay constant. Main result is f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV (with ~10% error) assuming QCD axion dark matter, but this is a single scalar bound presented in a Tosc-fa plane, not a tabulated m_a-f_a exclusion curve. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points with explicit numerical pairs are provided; the paper presents a Tosc vs fa band. Insufficient tabulated data to construct a reliable f_a-m_a curve.
